summary: Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K covering three items. Under Item 3.02, it disclosed an unregistered sale of 426,589 common shares at $24.86 per share, raising ~$10.6 million via subscription agreements with accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. Item 7.01 provided a portfolio update as of June 30, 2026: $1.995 billion loan commitments, 63 portfolio companies, 95% senior secured debt, weighted average yield 9.4%, net leverage 5.0x. Item 8.01 reported other events. This is a routine capital raise and portfolio disclosure, not a special situation. No tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or strategic review is present.
